articles.title: Bitcoin-backed mortgages are coming to Canada, but borrowers are still unaware of the cost
articles.snippet: Prospective borrowers face collateral liquidation risks if bitcoin prices drop, though APX said property and crypto collateral will be handled distinctly.

articles.title: CFTC chief poses questions about policing AI but calls it a road to 'autonomous trading'
articles.snippet: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission held a forum in which the chairman, Mike Selig, suggested AI agents may usher in a financial revolution.

articles.title: XRP Ledger developers propose creating wallets with zero XRP for stablecoin payments
articles.snippet: An experimental change would let companies cover the reserve for customer and AI-agent accounts, allowing users to start with stablecoins without first acquiring XRP.

articles.title: Settlement concerns prompt Euronext to halt CoinShares’ Zcash ETP ahead of debut
articles.snippet: A Euronext spokesperson told Cointelegraph the suspension was due to “operational settlement requirements” and remains in effect until settlement operations are supported by the CSD.

articles.title: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’
articles.snippet: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev says tokenized equities need more than a temporary SEC exemption to flourish in the US.
